sections.kicker: Prepared for Shaul Fadida by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Shaul wants to sell birthday workshops. Instagram does not mention them yet.
sections.keep: Your highlight named for workshops. It already shows the work people can join.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things

pins.what: Two brands share one small profile.
pins.why: A parent planning a birthday cannot tell if they are booking the designer or the school.
pins.how: Choose which name leads, and make the other its part.
pins.label: Your two names
pins.cost: Bookings split across two names that each look small.

pins.what: The bio says fashion designer, not workshop host.
pins.why: The birthday workshop is what you want to sell, and it is not named.
pins.how: Name the birthday and corporate workshop in the first line.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: People who would book never know they can.

pins.what: Your illustrations sit next to the workshops.
pins.why: They show taste no other sewing class has.
pins.how: Use them as the visual voice of the workshops.
pins.label: Your highlights
pins.cost: The thing that makes you different stays a side folder.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at your profile, and you said you want to share your work while selling bag making birthday workshops. Here are three things that would help most.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on Shaul Fadida's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.
